references.text: Oholiab, son of Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan, is also mentioned here as Bezalel's assistant, appointed by God to work on the tabernacle.
Bezalel and Oholiab, together with other wise men, receive wisdom from the Lord to carry out the work on the sanctuary.
Oholiab, son of Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan, is described as a craftsman, artist, and embroiderer.
God puts His Spirit upon people and gives them abilities to lead and teach others, just as He gave Bezalel the ability to instruct.
Joshua was filled with the spirit of wisdom when Moses laid his hands on him, similar to how God gave Bezalel the ability to teach others.
God gives wisdom in the heart, just as He gave Solomon wisdom, in the same way He gave Bezalel the ability to instruct.
An encouragement to bow one's heart to wisdom and knowledge, reflecting God's gift of teaching ability to Bezalel.
God gives wisdom generously to those who ask for it, just as He gave Bezalel wisdom and the ability to teach others.
